claim: The ?demo=1 sample opens half-finished and resets without changing daily progress.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; assert four selected sample tiles, reset, demo-prefixed session keys, preserved daily storage, and cleared demo storage on exit

claim: Everyone receives the same puzzle from the published UTC daily seed.
sandbox: two fresh browser contexts; assert the UTC date seed and identical generated solutions

claim: A round is designed to take three to five minutes.
sandbox: generate representative daily puzzles; assert the documented 20-second-per-tile pace yields 180 to 300 seconds

claim: Progress stays in this browser and the game sends no cross-origin requests.
sandbox: fresh browser context; place a tile, reload, assert restored route, and inspect every outgoing request origin

claim: A daily route reaches an end screen, opens archive practice, and can be restarted.
sandbox: fresh browser context; play the published solution, assert end screen and archive action, restart, reload, and assert archive access

claim: Archive practice opens only after today’s UTC daily route is complete.
sandbox: fresh browser context; deny direct practice with no marker and yesterday’s marker, then allow it only when the marker exactly matches today’s UTC seed

claim: Practice puzzles use published seeds and do not affect the daily route.
sandbox: save a partial daily route, set today’s completion marker, assert practice=1 publishes yesterday’s UTC seed, complete it, and assert daily storage is unchanged

claim: The puzzle works with keyboard and touch input.
sandbox: fresh keyboard context and a separate 390px touch context; complete the published route in each

claim: Mouse clicks follow the same route rules.
sandbox: fresh browser context; use page.mouse clicks on every step of the published sample solution and assert the end screen

claim: Each published date has a known route that can be completed.
sandbox: generate representative published-date puzzles, apply each known solution, and assert completion

claim: The game shows the date seed before play and a route code after completion.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the visible UTC seed before play, finish the published solution, and assert its visible route code

claim: Route rendering sustains at least 50 frames per second in the test browser.
sandbox: fresh demo page; count requestAnimationFrame callbacks over one second and require at least 50

claim: The daily puzzle is free and starts without an account or payment step.
sandbox: fresh browser context; assert the playable grid is visible with no account fields, buy action, subscription, or payment step

claim: A puzzle that is already loaded remains playable if the browser goes offline.
sandbox: new browser context; load /demo, set that context offline, place the next route tile, and assert progress
